text:
**Given feed (mass fractions) → convert to overall mole fractions \(z_i\)** (take 1.000 kg basis)

\[
m_1=0.30\text{ kg}=300\text{ g},\quad 
m_2=400\text{ g},\quad 
m_3=300\text{ g}
\]

\[
n_1=\frac{300}{78.11}=3.8418\ \text{mol},\;
n_2=\frac{400}{92.14}=4.3417\ \text{mol},\;
n_3=\frac{300}{106.17}=2.8258\ \text{mol}
\]
\[
n_F=11.0093\ \text{mol}
\]
\[
z_1=0.3490,\quad z_2=0.3944,\quad z_3=0.2566
\]

Total pressure:
\[
P=120\ \text{kPa}=\frac{120}{0.133322}=900.105\ \text{mmHg}
\]

Antoine:
\[
\log_{10} P_i^{sat}(\text{mmHg})=A_i-\frac{B_i}{C_i+T(^\circ C)}
\]
\[
K_i=\frac{P_i^{sat}}{P}
\]

---

## (a) Bubble-point temperature at 120 kPa

At bubble point (incipient vaporization), liquid composition \(x=z\) and Raoult’s law gives:
\[
\sum_i x_i P_i^{sat}(T)=P \quad \Rightarrow \quad \sum_i z_i P_i^{sat}(T)=P
\]

Trial at \(T=107^\circ\text{C}\):

- Benzene:
  \[
  \log_{10}P_1^{sat}=6.90565-\frac{1211.033}{220.790+107}=3.21165
  \Rightarrow P_1^{sat}=1628\ \text{mmHg}
  \]
- Toluene:
  \[
  P_2^{sat}=681.7\ \text{mmHg}
  \]
- o-Xylene:
  \[
  P_3^{sat}=251.7\ \text{mmHg}
  \]

\[
\sum z_i P_i^{sat}=0.3490(1628)+0.3944(681.7)+0.2566(251.7)
=901.5\ \text{mmHg}
\]

Need \(900.105\) mmHg, so slightly lower \(T\). Linear correction using \(T=108^\circ C\) gives:
\[
T_{bub}\approx 106.94^\circ\text{C}
\]

---

## (b) Dew-point temperature at 120 kPa

At dew point (incipient condensation), vapor composition \(y=z\) and:
\[
\sum_i \frac{y_i}{K_i}=1
\quad \Rightarrow \quad
\sum_i y_i\frac{P}{P_i^{sat}(T)}=1
\quad \Rightarrow \quad
\sum_i z_i\frac{P}{P_i^{sat}(T)}=1
\]

Trial at \(T=123.6^\circ\text{C}\):

Compute \(P_i^{sat}\):
\[
P_1^{sat}=2456,\quad P_2^{sat}=1080,\quad P_3^{sat}=423.6\ \text{mmHg}
\]

\[
\sum z_i\frac{P}{P_i^{sat}}
=0.3490\frac{900.105}{2456}
+0.3944\frac{900.105}{1080}
+0.2566\frac{900.105}{423.6}
=1.0023
\]

Slightly high → increase \(T\) a bit. Interpolating with \(T=124^\circ C\) (sum \(\approx0.9905\)):

\[
T_{dew}\approx 123.68^\circ\text{C}
\]

---

## (c) Isothermal flash at \(T=112^\circ\text{C}\), \(P=120\text{ kPa}\): find \(V/F=\beta\)

First compute \(P_i^{sat}\) at \(112^\circ\text{C}\):

\[
P_1^{sat}=1843,\quad P_2^{sat}=788.6,\quad P_3^{sat}=295.5\ \text{mmHg}
\]

\[
K_1=\frac{1843}{900.105}=2.047,\quad
K_2=\frac{788.6}{900.105}=0.8761,\quad
K_3=\frac{295.5}{900.105}=0.3283
\]

Rachford–Rice:
\[
f(\beta)=\sum_i \frac{z_i\left(K_i-1\right)}{1+\beta\left(K_i-1\right)}=0
\]

Solving between 0 and 1 gives (root near 0.33):
\[
\beta = \frac{V}{F}\approx 0.3284
\]

---

## (d) For (c), benzene mole fraction in vapor \(y_1\)

Liquid composition in flash:
\[
x_i=\frac{z_i}{1+\beta(K_i-1)}
\]

With \(\beta=0.3284\):

\[
x_1=\frac{0.3490}{1+0.3284(2.047-1)}=\frac{0.3490}{1.3438}=0.2597
\]

Then
\[
y_1=K_1 x_1 = 2.047(0.2597)=0.5316
\]

---

## (e) Temperature such that exactly half vaporized: \(V/F=\beta=0.5\)

Use Rachford–Rice with fixed \(\beta=0.5\):
\[
\sum_i \frac{z_i(K_i-1)}{1+0.5(K_i-1)}=0
\]
with \(K_i(T)=P_i^{sat}(T)/P\).

Trial:

- At \(T=114.8^\circ C\): \(f\approx -0.0011\)
- At \(T=115.0^\circ C\): \(f\approx +0.0042\)

Linear interpolation:
\[
T \approx 114.8 + \frac{0-(-0.0011)}{0.0042-(-0.0011)}(0.2)=114.84^\circ C
\]

---

FINAL (a): 106.94 °C  
FINAL (b): 123.68 °C  
FINAL (c): 0.3284 1  
FINAL (d): 0.5316 1  
FINAL (e): 114.84 °C
